summary: node1 now boots with audit=1 persistently. Reboot verification confirmed a changed boot identity, live audit activation, recovered health, and the unchanged RHEL 7.9 release/kernel.
actions_performed: Backed up the original GRUB configuration.
Added audit=1 to the persistent GRUB defaults and all Linux boot entries using RHEL 7-compatible grubby.
Restarted node1 safely and verified recovery.
Confirmed /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and the kernel audit state reports enabled 1.

evidence.summary: GRUB defaults and both normal/rescue boot entries contain audit=1; the setting remained after restart.

evidence.requirement: Boot the kernel with audit enabled
evidence.summary: Post-restart /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and auditctl reports enabled 1.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: RHEL Server 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 were unchanged before and after restart.

Baseline was healthy; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed from 73bafeef-b823-49b3-8e3d-17981e865b31 to cebb3f62-171c-484c-90a2-e702c4fb06c7; system returned to running with sshd active, writable root filesystem, readable release data, and zero failed units.
